name: pccard
notes: The 5420-byte 68k library identifies as pccard.library 1.1 (23.11.2002). The Aminet 3c589 1.5 bundle and pccardserial 1.1 bundle contain identical copies. The standalone pccard 2.2 archive supplies a different build.

The shipped 3c589.device references this library and retains its own package boundary. cnet.device accesses card.resource directly. Stock has no pccardserial.device, pccardserial.guide or adjacent L: component.
